CASCADE_CHANGE.NAME: Phase-101: CI/CD Pipeline — Git Init + GitHub Actions Workflows

WHAT_CHANGED.CHANGE: .github/workflows/ci.yml — full CI pipeline: quality (check+test+clippy+fmt), bench-check (compile only), grace (verify+refresh+status)
.github/workflows/release.yml — on tag v*: build release binary → package tarball → SHA256 checksum → publish to GitHub Releases + tarpaulin coverage upload
rust-toolchain.toml — pin Rust 1.95.0 with clippy+rustfmt components
README.md — add CI badge (github.com/anyagixx/synapse/actions) + release badge

WHY.REASON: Honest assessment gap #1: no CI/CD, no git repo, no automated quality gates. Every check (test, clippy, fmt, verify, bench) ran manually. This is the #1 blocker to production readiness.

IMPACT.POSITIVE: All quality gates now automated via GitHub Actions: check → test → clippy → fmt → bench-compile → GRACE verify → GRACE refresh → status. Release workflow auto-builds and publishes on tag. CI badge visible in README. Repository initialized with full history.
IMPACT.NOTE: CI workflows cannot be tested in sandbox — they will execute on first push to GitHub. Workflow files follow GitHub Actions syntax and use dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable for Rust installation.

VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE.CHECK: Valid GitHub Actions workflow: on push/PR, 3 jobs (quality, bench-check, grace)
Valid GitHub Actions workflow: on tag v*, build+package+publish+coverage

BELIEF_STATE_UPDATES.UPDATE: CI pipeline: 3 jobs (quality 30min, bench-check 20min, grace 20min). Rust 1.95.0 pinned. Caching enabled.
Release pipeline: Linux x86_64 only (macOS deferred). tarpaulin coverage uploaded as artifact.
